scene iodatewar1
show sunday
$ day = 7
$ totaldays += 1
I didn’t sleep well last night.
As it turns out, I’m haunted whether I dream or not. The only difference is the one behind the spectral wheel.
So I guess I’ll just resign myself to a life where I never feel rested again and let my body get carried off by the wind to whatever dump the universe has in store for me next.
Something tells me there will be a girl there. That much is all but guaranteed when they’re somehow more accessible to me than air.
That isn’t me bragging, I promise. I’m sure you’d be drowning in suitors too if all of the competition suddenly vanished. So maybe you can bank on that.
Just know that every monkey’s paw is cursed — and being wanted isn’t something I’d suggest you want yourself.
Of course, there’s always a chance I’m just projecting here. And that you’re off somewhere else, being happier and more loved than I am.
Actually, come to think of it, that sounds pretty plausible.
If that is the case, though — maybe I can ask you a question this time instead of just providing you with unsolicited advice on how to fuck everything up.
Where would I even begin, though?
Who are you, maybe?
Who have I been talking to this whole time? Who is it that keeps me sane when all else seems to advocate for the opposite?
scene iodatewar2
I don’t even know where to start.
We’re so close, yet so far. You know everything about me and I know nothing about you.
But maybe there’s something that can bring us together.
scene iodatewar3
Maybe there’s something that-
scene iodatewar4
scene iodatewar5
: Why do you sleep like that?
: Why are you in my room?
scene iodatewar6
: Why is it already that hard? Are you just like this by default?
: Unfortunately, yes.
: Gross.
: Thanks, Io. I always love being insulted as soon as I wake up. Now, to get back to my first question-
scene iodatewar7
: Jeez, Sensei. You act like there’s no precedent for this.
: Every time you go to sleep, you should be thinking to yourself, “there is a possibility that Io will pick the lock and I will wake up beside her.” Would it kill you to act accordingly?
: Kill me, no. But having any amount of time to myself might be-
scene iodatewar8
: Actually, nevermind. It’s probably good that you’re here.
: Right! Plus, this gives us more time for our date! It’s a good thing my anxiety ate away at me and forced me to sneak into your hotel room again! Praise my broken mind!
scene iodatewar9
: Maaaaybe put on pants first, though.
if iosex == True:
: Unless this is the part where you put it inside of me again. Which, as always, ew. But if it earns me any date points and gets you to enjoy my company any more-
: Io, stop that.
: I can’t! Conditioning is fun!
: Just...go wait outside of the room and I’ll be out in a minute.
scene iodatewar10
: Fine. But if you escape outside of the window to try and get away from me, just know that it will make me really sad and that I won’t actually do anything about it because I’m weak and I suck.
: I will...keep that in mind.
scene black
Io steps out and, hopefully, isn’t accosted by any of her classmates wondering why she’s outside of my room.
I figure it’s either that or all of them are outside of my room, joined by a camera crew and providing commentary on how they expect this thing to go.
From what I understand, the girls have always really liked this “date war” stuff — even when they’re not the ones who get to take me out.
I think they just like the idea that it could be them. And that it likely will be them if we go through enough of these.
And I bet all of the ones who are thinking that are jumping for joy right now given that my dates this year are my perpetual best friend and...whatever they see Io as.
What do they see Io as?
I know how Uta does, but...do the rest even see her at all?
Or is going out with her going to be one more situation akin to holding hands with a ghost?
scene iodatewar11
Find out now — because we’re already at her favorite place in the world.
: Green tea...energy drink. Which one is better for spelunking?
: Which one is better for what?
scene iodatewar12
: Spelunking. It’s when you-
: I know what it is, Io.
: Then why did you ask?
: Because it’s the first hint of what this “date” has in store and is perhaps the most wildly different scenario I have encountered in all of these so far.
: Thanks. I take great pride in being an unlikable outcast with fringe interests that may or may not annoy you.
: You’re a very likable outcast. I’m just not sure if I’m built for cave exploration.
: Then it sounds to me like you could use a green tea. Or an energy drink. Which one of those sounds like it would be more useful?
: Io-
scene iodatewar13
: Relax, okay? I’m not throwing you into an actual cave. That’s a third date activity.
: I’m just taking you back to the secret tunnel that I know you already explored with Uta since I always wanted to be the one to show you that place.
: Oh. Well, why didn’t you then?
: Why do you think?
: Because you’re a cowardly loser who gets off on self-inflicted pain?
scene iodatewar14
: I mean, that’s not really how I would word it. But yeah, that’s more or less the answer I was looking for. The only problem is I still don’t know what to buy you.
: Wait, it’s for me?
: Yeah. Am I not supposed to buy you things? We’re on a date.
: Isn’t that usually-
: If you’re about to perpetuate gender norms at me, let it be known that I am far more traditionally masculine than you are.
: I hate that you’re right.
scene iodatewar15
: Don’t! Because that stuff doesn’t matter!
: It clearly matters a little if you’ve aimed all of your hate specifically at girls and not-
: Okaaaay, so it matters in some specific circumstances! But again, I am a hypocrite! And I think the important thing right now is taking into account that I am bringing you on a date!
: Doesn’t it make the most sense for the date aggressor to be the one who has to provide material goods for the date prey?
: Sorry, are you calling me your prey right now?
: Just because I’m nervous and couldn’t think of a better word! Beverage?
: Give me the tea.
scene iodatewar16
: As expected of the prey.
: Fine. Give me the energy drink, then.
scene black
: Nope! You’ve already made up your mind!
: Come, Sensei! Or shall I say — darling, ala romantic stereotypes that mean nothing to me but make me feel weirdly warm inside now that I say them out loud.
scene sky
Hanging out with Io on a date is kind of like...well, the way it always is when I hang out with Io. Just slightly more...cute, I guess?
Which isn’t to say she isn’t normally cute. She’s adorable when she’s not insulting everyone she knows (including herself).
But she’s extra attentive today. And keeps offering me snacks out of a large plastic bag she’s been clutching ever since we left the convenience store.
Which — and hear me out here because this is going to sound weird due to the fact that I am attracted to her — makes her feel almost...grandmotherly?
Like, Touka never offers me snacks. Or spends ten minutes on a walk to a secret tunnel talking about the effects of various sleeping pills.
I swear, it’s like Io is one or two steps away from calling me “Sonny Boy” and selling me a membership badge so I can use the community pool.
Wait, what?
Why did I-
scene iodatewar17
: Sensei — you’ve been counting our steps, right?
: Our steps? I thought all I had to do was count the amount of turns we made and stuff.
: Yeah, that. Status report, navigator. Your captain has issued a command.
: Thirteen lefts and nine rights. Obviously not in that order.
: I’ve also been keeping track of that part. But how many-
: Fifteen grates or vents or...whatever it is you want to call them. With the most recent being literally right behind us.
scene iodatewar18
: Roger! We’re probably getting close then.
: To what?
: The end of the line! Where the new half of town meets the old half and causes a rift in the time and space continuum we can throw ourselves into to become finally happy!
scene iodatewar19
: Oh. Well, why didn’t you just say so? A time rift is way better than how dates normally end. And significantly more your speed.
: That’d be cool, wouldn’t it? Unfortunately, I am a liar. And I am leading you to a secret location where I can murder you and conveniently dispose of the body.
: This day just keeps getting better.
: Okay, no more lies this time. There’s a secret room built into the wall with a high-tech keypad that we’re going to crack the code for together.
: I thought you said no more lies?
: I did. I’m serious this time.
scene iodatewar20
: I’m sorry, what?
: Did Uta not tell you about it? I know we promised to keep it a secret, but I figured she would have blabbed to you since you guys are like, a thing now and stuff.
: We’re not a thing, Io.
: You better be a thing, Sensei. Because if I find out you’re using my best friend, I will once again be very sad but ultimately not do anything about it.
: Like really sad this time, though. And I’ll probably hate you for a few minutes before caving and convincing myself I don’t.
scene iodatewar21
: If you’re worried about me using her or something, I can promise that’s not what’s happening.
: Uta’s...important, obviously. But I think that she understands just as well as me that I am being pulled in a million different directions and...one of those just happens to be her.
scene iodatewar22
: If that upsets you, I get it. But it’s not like-
: Something’s different.
scene iodatewar23
: I know. That’s what I’m trying to-
: Not with you and Uta. With the tunnel. Be quiet.
scene iodatewar24
: Can you hear that?
: I can’t really hear anything. But you know this place better than me, so-
: You’re sure we’ve passed fifteen sewer grates, right?
: I...think so? But keep in mind that I never claimed to be an effective navigator. So if we’ve gotten lost, I think you should take some of the blame for bringing me here.
: No, I don’t think we’re lost. I kept the instructions on my phone. There’s just...something different. And I’m not sure what-
scene iodatewar25
: Is that...light? Do you see that?
: A light at the end of a tunnel? Did it cave in on us while we were bickering or something? Are we dead now?
: It’s not just one. It’s...
scene black
: Come on! Let’s check it out!
: Io, don’t run. It’s dark in here and I don’t want to have to carry you out if-
scene iodatewar26
: Holy shit...
Right there in the middle of the tunnel is a ledge, haphazardly marked with several small street barriers as if it doesn’t just suddenly descend into nothing but a sea of black.
From out its depths crawl thousands of dust particles, illuminated and brought to life by the light of the sun, falling endlessly from a separate abyss extending above.
I can hear water. I can hear air. I can hear everything. But at the same time, there’s an inescapable, terrifying silence that finds its way between Io and me.
The two of us feed that silence in our confusion, left to do nothing but stand there and gawk at one more inexplicable feat of this even more inexplicable city.
Just I am used to this. And she is-
: This...
: Is so...
scene iodatewar27
: Fucking cool!
: We encounter an endless pit of darkness in the middle of a tunnel, coming one or two steps from falling into it, and your response is to call it cool?
scene iodatewar28
: Fuck yeah it is! Who gives a shit about a secret door with a dumb keypad when we’ve found the edge of the friggin’ world?!
scene iodatewar29
: Don’t jump in, though. And don’t push me either. I was only joking when I talked about hiding your body. I swear I didn’t know this was here.
scene iodatewar30
: This is so weird, though. I’ve been down here with Uta tons of times and we’ve never seen anything like this. It’s almost like the tunnel is-
: Changing?
: Yeah...
scene iodatewar31
: But if that’s the case, what are these barrier things doing here? Don’t they indicate that someone knows about this?
: Construction maybe?
: New businesses are popping up all over the place. Maybe one of them was connected to the tunnels and-
: No, that wouldn’t explain how deep it is. The only thing that would-
scene iodatewar32
: Ah! Sensei! Do you know what I think this is?!
: A rift in the time and space continuum that we can throw ourselves into to become happy?
: No! But you’re close!
scene iodatewar33
: I think this might be the sinkhole that swallowed the school Uta and I transferred in from.
: I don’t really see how that’s close, but okay.
: It’s close because it’s a crack in reality! Something that shouldn’t happen, but did.
: No one expects an entire school to just disappear, just like no one expects a rift that grants happiness to open up somewhere in the sky or wherever it is rifts form.
: Well...if it is, what does that mean?
scene iodatewar34
: That I can finally get my old pencil case back!
: Io, please don’t tell me you’re actually planning on jumping into a giant hole that disappears into nothingness.
: Jumping? No. We just need a lot of rope.
: Please don’t venture into the sinkhole. This is a formal request from your former teacher.
scene iodatewar35
: Aww, Sensei. I’ve always wanted someone to be worried enough about me to ask me not to jump into a bottomless pit.
: Well, if it’s actually the sinkhole that claimed your school, it would have a bottom. Right?
: Oh, you know what I mean.
scene iodatewar36
: What do we do now, though? Like, we’re obviously not the first ones to find it based on the barriers. But I can’t just ignore something as cool as this.
: So...what? You want to keep investigating?
: I say we regroup. We’ll return to the surface and enlist the help of Uta to go scream into the sinkhole from the top and see if we can hear her from down here.
: Do they not have the hole blocked off up there?
: They do. But we’ve snuck into plenty of stuff we’re not allowed into. It’s one of the ways we bond.
: You do realize I still have another date after this, right?
: You do realize that no date you could ever go on after this one will possibly live up to the wonder of a giant hole, right?
: The giant hole is only a wonder at all because I got to see it with you.
: I still think it’d be pretty cool even if I were by myself right now.
: Then I guess that just means I like you more.
: I respectfully disagree.
: Actually, no. I disrespectfully disagree. I think you are wrong and dumb and that I like you more. And I will not apologize for this assessment of our relationship.
: Oh. Okay.
: Also, you should kiss me.
scene iodatewar37
: Like...now?
: Yeah. I’m jealous that Uta gets to and I don’t.
: But I also understand if you’re disgusted by the idea of doing something like that with me since you won’t be my first.
scene iodatewar38
: That doesn’t disgust me, Io.
: It should.
: But you can take solace in the fact that this will be my first consensual kiss if that helps wash away any of the grossness.
: There’s nothing gross about you.
: Yes there is.
: No...there’s not.
: I respectfully disagree.
: Actually, no. I disrespectfully disagree. I think you are wrong and dumb and that I am damaged beyond repair.
: That statement implies I want to fix you.
: Do you not?
: No. I fear that “fixed” Io would be unrecognizable, so I’m willing to accept whatever spare pieces and parts this one has left to offer.
: They are yours if you will have them. But I would like to ask for something of yours in return, if that’s okay.
: And what is it you would like?
: I don’t know yet.
: And to be honest, I’m not sure I ever will. So don’t be surprised if I continue to ask for something new every day for the rest of eternity.
: Or at least until one of us falls into the sinkhole.
scene iodatewar39
: Are you really sure you want to do this?
: No.
: Should I...stop then?
: No.
: I am receiving mixed signals here that I feel like I shouldn’t ignore based on your history.
: Frankly speaking, Sensei, I’d like to forget basically all of my history that doesn’t involve you or Uta.
: And, assuming that’s possible, I think having my “first” kiss in front of a bottomless pit sounds like a pretty great memory and the perfect end to an actual first date.
: I still feel like this is wrong and that I should give you more time.
: Okay. I’ll just do it myself then.
: You’ll-
scene iodatewar40
: Mmf?
: Chu...chu...chu...
scene iodatewar41
I melt into her.
: Heheh...chu...heh...
But she starts...laughing?
scene iodatewar42
: Hm? Why’d you stop?
: People don’t normally laugh.
: Really? It kind of tickles. Kissing like this.
: Plus, you look dumb when you have to crouch down like that. It’s cute.
: Io-
: Keep going. I want more.
Hah...
scene iodatewar41
I melt again.
scene black
And all I am drips slowly from the ledge that leads into a sea of nothing.
